title: The Month I Tracked Everything
sentences: Last March I wrote down every single thing that I spent money on.
I expected the big costs to be rent and food.
Rent was indeed the largest, but the second largest genuinely surprised me.
I had spent nearly two hundred dollars on lunches bought at work.
None of those lunches had felt like a decision at the time I bought them.
That is what made them so easy to ignore.
Since then I have taken food from home three days a week, more or less.
I do not enjoy preparing it, and there are days when I give up entirely.
Even so, I am saving roughly a hundred dollars every month.
The tracking turned out to be more useful than any advice I had ever read.
